headline_hook: Google Ships AI Music, Claude Goes Mobile, and NVIDIA Squeezes Reasoning Into 3B Params
preview_topics: where all that AI-generated code actually goes

pick_of_the_day.thesis: Nemotron-Cascade-2 using only 3B active parameters to match full-size reasoners isn't just an efficiency win — it signals that reasoning capability is about to escape the data center and land on laptops, phones, and edge devices, collapsing the moat between frontier labs and everyone else.

model_literacy.relevance: Three stories today — TurboQuant, Qwen3.5 GGUF, and Nemotron-Cascade — all attack the same problem from different angles: making big models run small. Quantization reduces numerical precision (FP16→INT4) while compression techniques like cascaded MoE activate only a fraction of total parameters. Understanding these tradeoffs explains why 'runs on my GPU' models are suddenly competitive.
